title: Vanity Top Accessorie Toilet Tissue Holder, Solid Brass Countertop Stand, 6-Inch Height - | Oil Rubbed Bronze | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom vanity with a vanity top accessorie toilet tissue holder crafted from solid brass, designed for easy countertop placement when wall space is limited in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom.

  • Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Space-saving design: Keeps a roll within reach without wall mounting
  • Surface protection: Felt pad helps prevent scratching

Specs

  • Mounting type: Countertop
  • Dimensions: 5.5-Inch length x 5-Inch width x 6-Inch height
  • Weight: 4 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Vanity Top Toilet Tissue Holder
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Works well with modern bathroom hardware, contemporary bath accessories, and minimalist bathroom fixtures.
